Bug_Details:
This cast will always throw a ClassCastException.
SpotBugs tracks type information from instanceof checks,
and also uses more precise information about the types
of values returned from methods and loaded from fields.
Thus, it may have more precise information than just
the declared type of a variable, and can use this to determine
that a cast will always throw an exception at runtime.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by attempting to cast an Integer object to a String. Since an Integer cannot be cast to a String without an explicit conversion, this cast will always throw a ClassCastException at runtime.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUnit test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug method of the ImpossibleCastExample class. This method contains an impossible cast from Integer to String, which will always throw a ClassCastException.
